description: Extract a product profile from a product page URL: name, description, image URLs (the first three are listed), and the extraction method used. Works on Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, or any page with JSON-LD / OpenGraph product metadata. Free. pixeldojo_campaign and pixeldojo_ad accept a product URL and run this extraction themselves; call this directly to check the product data first, or to reuse its images in other tools.
